text: Code review is where good teams slow down. Pull requests wait for hours, feedback varies by reviewer, and the same mistakes keep slipping through.
Meet Diffwise. An AI reviewer that lives inside your GitHub.
Install the GitHub App on a repository in one click. No config files. No pipelines to maintain.
Then just open a pull request. Diffwise takes it from there.
GitHub sends a webhook, a job is queued, a worker fetches the diff, and an LLM reviews every changed line.
Within seconds, inline comments land on the pull request. A missing null check. A query open to injection. Each with a suggested fix.
A dashboard keeps the full history: every review, your settings, and exactly what you use.
Next: repo context with embeddings, per-tenant quotas, cost tracking, and monitoring at scale.
Diffwise. Reviews that never wait. Join the early access list today.
